Works offline. Built for anxious founders, overwhelmed creators and anyone who’s tried 4 cups of coffee just to focus. Free to start. No pills. No meditation journeys. Just breathe.

records.name: The Daily Auction
records.tagline: A website that auctions itself daily. Winner edits for 24h.
records.description: The website that auctions itself off every day on Solana. Winner controls a Codex agent to edit the website. The auction mechanism is an English auction with a reserve price of 0.1 SOL. The Codex agent operates in a sandbox where it can only output HTML/CSS/JS. The project is open-source, and you can verify the correctness of the on-chain auction contract.

records.name: Exofansy
records.tagline: Exofansy – social platform for sharing content
records.description: Share your memories, connect with others, make new friends and make money 💰

records.name: syswaifu
records.tagline: #cli #anime #terminal #waifu
records.description: A Cross-Platform Neofetch-style system info with waifu images in terminal - iamovi/syswaifu

records.name: Dataset Labs
records.tagline: The fastest way to build LLM training data
records.description: Generate thousands of high-quality, grounded training examples. Define your schema, pull from real sources, start fine-tuning today.

records.name: Learn Nepali touch typing
records.tagline: nepali typing practice  finger and keyboard guides
records.description: Free Preeti Font Typing Practice online. Prepare for Loksewa Ayog computer operator exams. Learn Nepali typing with finger guides, real-time speed tracking, and instant feedback.

records.name: ImageWand
records.tagline: Your privacy-first image toolkit with AI superpowers.
records.description: The all-in-one image workspace. Use 10+ free tools like resize, crop, and compress locally in your browser (privacy-first). Upgrade to access professional AI features like background removal and 4K upscaling.

records.name: Move The Needle
records.tagline: A calm AI tool to track meaningful progress on goals
records.description: A calm, AI-powered goal and progress tracker for founders and small business owners. Set one goal, get a roadmap, and move the needle daily.

records.name: booksofme
records.tagline: try booksofme and show-off your readings.
records.description: I love reading. But I hated how invisible it felt. No proof. No progress. No place to show it. So I built something.

records.name: ImmoRender.ai
records.tagline: Turn hand-drawn floor plans into 3D in a few minutes!
records.description: ImmoRender uses AI to transform hand-drawn floor plan sketches into professional 3D visualizations in a few minutes. Perfect for real estate agents and property sellers who need stunning visuals without expensive agencies or complex CAD software. Simply upload a photo of your sketch → AI extracts the floor plan → Choose your style (Modern, Scandinavian, Industrial, Luxury) → Download your 3D. No design skills required. 100x cheaper than traditional rendering agencies.

records.name: one elsewhere
records.tagline: Don’t touch. Stay focused.
records.description: It is a focus challenge. Start a run, put your phone down, and don’t touch it. Your ship keeps flying while you stay away from the screen. The moment you touch the phone — the flight ends. One-tap start with a short countdown Achievements for milestones (minutes, planets, deep space) Ships to unlock and choose from Minimal, calm UI designed to disappear while you do real things Use it while working, studying, reading, writing, training, or doing anything that needs uninterrupted attention.

records.name: Bit Sketchy!
records.tagline: A simple drawing party game where no skill is required
records.description: Bit Sketchy! is a simple, in-person drawing party game I built as a personal project. One device with the app sits on the table to show the drawing prompts for everyone to draw. After the round is finished the secret judging criteria is revealed, and the discussion begins... It’s intentionally simple, not about drawing skill, and mostly an experiment to see whether the concept is fun. I’d love feedback from anyone who tries it. Available on the iOS & Mac App Stores

records.name: MTV REWIND
records.tagline: 24/7 music video streaming-MTV when it actually played music
records.description: MTV stopped playing music videos 20 years ago. MTV REWIND brings back the golden era of music television - 35,000 videos spanning 1970-2025 across 8 channels (70s, 80s, 90s, 2000s, 2010s, 2020s, Yo! MTV Raps, Headbangers Ball). No ads. No algorithm. No login. Just press play and discover music the way it used to be - completely random, completely free. Built in 48 hours as a passion project. The nostalgia hits different.

records.name: Ginny & Georgia Quiz
records.tagline: Find Your Ginny & Georgia Twin
records.description: Take our Ginny & Georgia quiz to discover which character matches your personality! Are you more Georgia, Ginny, Marcus, or Joe? Find out in 2 minutes.

records.name: Analysent | AI Market Sentiment Engine
records.tagline: Precision sentiment analysis for stocks and crypto.
records.description: Analysent AI: High-Performance Sentiment Intelligence. Stop navigating through financial noise. Analysent AI is a professional browser extension that provides institutional-grade sentiment analysis for stocks and crypto. It extracts critical data from complex news to deliver objective, high-conviction insights instantly. ✅ Catalyst Extraction: Isolates the specific driver behind price action. ✅ Precision Delivery: Concise, three-sentence professional insights.

records.name: Uber Clone, Uber Clone App - Launch now
records.tagline: Where On-Demand Ideas Become Live Businesses
records.description: Looking to launch your own taxi booking business? Our Uber clone app offers a seamless user experience, built on a proven script that’s customizable, reliable, and ready to scale. Partner with Unimak Technologies and transform your taxi service with our industry-leading Uber Clone App, White Label Taxi Booking App, Taxi Dispatch Software, and On-demand Taxi App solutions. For more information, get in touch with us today! Email: business@unimaktechnologies.com Phone: +919677597973

records.name: Sub Rosa
records.tagline: An e2e secret sharing website with client-side encryption
records.description: Sub Rosa is a zero-knowledge secret sharer. We physically cannot read your messages. Most tools generate keys on the server. We don't. Your browser encrypts data locally using the Web Crypto API. The key lives in the URL hash (#) and never touches our logs or database. We only store the encrypted blob, which is burned instantly after reading. 100% Open Source. No ads. No trackers. Just privacy.

records.name: ColorQueueList
records.tagline: Instant Entry x Color Clarity
records.description: ColorQueueList is a lightning-fast task manager: type an idea and hit Enter—done. No menus, no friction. Color-coded categories make priorities instantly readable: free includes Today/Tasks/Important, while Pro unlocks unlimited custom categories with your own names and colors. Built for real life: swipe to switch, complete, or delete; finished items auto-fold and purge after 7 days. No account, no sync, data stays on-device. Keyboard-first, it keeps you moving—capture, sort, finish. In seconds.

records.name: Simplify
records.tagline: One App, Total wellness!
records.description: Simplify is an all-in-one routine and wellness app designed to help you stay organised, stay healthy, and take back control of your day. Tired of switching between different apps for planning, workouts, hydration, meals, and habits? Simplify puts everything in one clean, easy-to-use space, so you can breathe, focus, and live better. With Simplify, you can manage your daily schedule, stay consistent with fitness, eat healthier, track your menstrual cycle, and build habits that actually stick.

records.name: AI Cinema Suite
records.tagline: AI tools for script, storyboard & film pre-production
records.description: AI Cinema Suite is an AI-powered toolkit built for filmmakers, writers, and producers during pre-production. It helps generate scripts, story ideas, character concepts, and planning assets using AI—saving time and boosting creativity before filming begins. Designed specifically for cinema workflows, AI Cinema Suite replaces scattered tools with one focused platform. 🎁 Early users get 500 free credits to try it out.

records.name: Oravida AI
records.tagline: Turn CVs/stories into AI portfolios that get you discovered
records.description: Oravida AI transforms resumes or career stories into AI-generated portfolio websites. We solve three critical job search problems: (1) Privacy: portfolios hide contact info behind spam-protected messaging, (2) Discoverability: semantic search finds you by actual skills, not keyword matching, (3) Visibility: analytics show who's viewing and how you're performing. Upload your resume or write a few lines, AI generates a beautiful portfolio, publish and get discovered. Stop sending invisible PDFs.

records.name: Membar
records.tagline: Track recurring tasks without rigid schedules
records.description: A simple Android app for tracking recurring tasks without rigid schedules or fixed dates. When you check off a task, its timer resets and starts counting, until the task becomes due and sends a notification. Made for routine activities like watering plants, changing filters, or getting up and stretching; activities you want to do regularly but not on a strict schedule. Useful for anyone who prefers a nudge and reminder over a calendar alarm. No ads. No accounts. No subscriptions. No data shared.

records.name: One Time Link
records.tagline: Securely share secrets in Slack with one-time links
records.description: One Time Link by Nurbak – Share Secrets for Slack lets teams securely share sensitive information inside Slack. Instead of sending passwords, API keys, or credentials in plain text, it creates one-time links that self-destruct after opening. Secrets are never stored in readable form, conversations stay clean, and teams reduce the risk of leaks — without changing their Slack workflows. Built for developers, DevOps, and growing teams who care about security, privacy, and simplicity.

records.name: UrlShorter
records.tagline: The All-in-One Link Shortener & Bio Page Builder
records.description: URLShorter.cc is the all-in-one link management platform for creators and agencies. Replace Bitly and Linktree with one powerful tool. Key Features: ✨ Create branded short links & custom QR codes 📱 Build stunning "Link-in-Bio" pages (No coding) 📊 Deep analytics & custom domains 🏢 White Label solution for agencies Boost your click-through rates on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube today.

records.name: UpHero
records.tagline: Win 4x more freelance jobs on Upwork with AI.
records.description: Stop losing bids. UpHero is the AI Upwork proposal generator that guarantees a 90% higher response rate. Create winning proposals in minutes and optimize your profile for top rankings. Start your free trial today!

records.name: El Gran Bazar
records.tagline: Connecting micro-businesses with customers in one click.
records.description: El Gran Bazar is a progressive web app (PWA) designed to empower local micro-businesses. We allow small merchants to publish their products easily and help customers find local goods without fees. It features a clean interface, discount sections, and direct seller contact.

records.name: StyloFront
records.tagline: All your frontend tools, finally in one place.
records.description: Modular platform with themes and developer tools. Simplify workflows, reduce setup time, and accelerate web development. Right now we are in beta version.

records.name: TubePrompter
records.tagline: Turn any video into AI prompts for Sora, Veo & Midjourney
records.description: TubePrompter is a free video to prompt generator that extracts AI-ready prompts from any video. How it works: 1. Paste a YouTube/TikTok/Instagram URL 2. AI analyzes camera angles, lighting, composition & style 3. Get scene-by-scene prompts optimized for Sora, Veo, Midjourney Key features: - Extracts "Visual DNA" (camera, lighting, mood) from videos - Scene-by-scene breakdown with start/end frames - One-click copy to any AI model - Remix subjects while keeping the viral aesthetic

records.name: SimpleXplain
records.tagline: Understand anything like you're 6 years old 🧒
records.description: SimpleXplain turns complex topics into fun, visual explanations that even a 6-year-old can understand. Just type any topic — blockchain, photosynthesis, quantum physics — and get: ✨ Simple explanation with fun analogies 🎨 Interactive visual diagrams 💡 Mind-blowing fun facts 🔗 Shareable links with beautiful previews No signup required. Perfect for curious minds, students, teachers, and anyone who loves learning!

records.name: QR Code Generator & Reader
records.tagline: QR code generator, QR code scanner, custom QR code,
records.description: Generate & scan QR codes with custom colors and logos. 100% private, no data sent.

records.name: AudioText Live
records.tagline: The Missing AI Layer for Your Phone Numbers
records.description: Don't just record calls, understand them. AudioText Live is the missing AI layer for Twilio, Telnyx, and SignalWire. We turn raw audio streams into searchable data via real-time transcription, speaker identification, and sentiment analysis.

records.name: 黑料
records.tagline: 黑料
records.description: 黑料网（heiliao.com）专注揭露网红黑料、明星丑闻等劲爆事件，聚合原创视频、反差社区、影视短剧、深夜综艺等优质爆料内容。每日更新吃瓜热点，快速掌握全网黑料爆点，是吃瓜群众首选的爆料聚集地。这里汇集最新最全的娱乐圈内幕，满足你的好奇心，让你第一时间了解明星网红的隐秘动态。无论是原创视频还是深度解析，黑料网都能为你提供最真实、最震撼的爆料体验。加入我们，成为吃瓜界的前沿者！

records.name: Aurora Invoice Generator
records.tagline: Powerful solution that create invoices instantly.
records.description: Online Invoice Generator Tool is a simple yet powerful solution that helps businesses create professional invoices instantly, without installing software or paying for subscriptions. This web-based tool lets you generate fully formatted invoices in just a few clicks. Simply enter your business details, client information, item names, quantities, prices, and taxes, the generator automatically calculates totals and creates a clean, printable invoice.

records.name: Bite Size
records.tagline: Turn AI conversations into ephemeral, shareable sites.
records.description: Bite Size is an MCP server that gives your AI the power to publish. During any conversation, Claude can instantly create a shareable website—no manual HTML, no copy-paste, no deployment. Ask Claude to visualize data? It builds an interactive chart and hands you a live URL. Brainstorm a landing page? It's already online. Explain a concept? Now it's a beautiful, shareable page anyone can visit. One tool. One prompt. A real website ready to share.

records.name: LLMObserve
records.tagline: Built a free tool to track LLM costs
records.description: llmobserve lets you: Track LLM usage and costs in real time Set spend caps and alerts See per-model, per-feature, and per-tenant usage Support multi-tenant SaaS setups Get everything running with a ~10-line code setup Use it for free (no card required) Providers we currently track OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (Gemini), Cohere, Mistral, Meta (Llama), Groq, DeepSeek, Pinecone Tear it apart. I’d much rather fix real problems now than ship something polished but useless.

records.name: CertAvert
records.tagline: Simple, free SSL certificate expiration monitoring
records.description: CertAvert offers free SSL/TLS certificate monitoring for up to 3 domains, with alerts before certificates expire. In addition to expiration tracking, CertAvert detects common certificate issues such as revoked certificates, hostname mismatches, etc. It provides a simple dashboard showing domain status and sends email alerts so issues can be fixed before users are affected. No agents, plugins, or uptime checks—focused only on SSL certificate monitoring.
